relevant_laws.quote: Except when overtaking and passing on the right is permitted, the driver of an overtaken vehicle shall give way to the right in favor of the overtaking vehicle upon observing the overtaking vehicle or hearing a signal.
relevant_laws.notes: Frozen paved-road travel/other-vehicle cell; distinguish overtaken-driver rightward response after observed/audible notice, speed before complete passing, and separately sourced right-pass permission.
